title: Introductory Quiz (English)
description: Sample quiz with questions for both kids and adults.

barnQuestions.text: What color is a ripe banana?
How many legs does a spider have?

vuxenQuestions.text: In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
vuxenQuestions.explanation: The Berlin Wall fell in November 1989.

vuxenQuestions.text: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
vuxenQuestions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word Aurum.

vuxenQuestions.text: Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
vuxenQuestions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
